alex_ops: Hey team, seeing a short spike of 502/504s hitting hostedapi edge in eu-west-1 around bulk-embeds. Surfaced at ~11:12 UTC. Sample request-id 4b8f9a72, trace=trace-id:abc123.
kevin_sre: Can you paste a curl or sample request that repros? Any pattern on payloads / batch sizes?
alex_ops: Mostly large embed batches (300-500 vectors in single request). curl sample: `curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings -d '{\"model\":\"embed-4b\",\"input\":[... large array ...]}'`
maria_support: Ticket from customer A-879 mentioned latency then 502s, they recorded 4b8f9a72 as well. Customer says errors started after a config change to reduce connect timeout in their SDK.
jordan_eng: Logs from edge show a lot of `upstream reset` + `response code 502` from Envoy, and intermittently `upstream request timeout` causing 504. I also see `connection: keep-alive` churn on midproxy pools.
kevin_sre: Hypothesis: persistent connection drift combined with auth-cache TTL evictions are causing sudden short upstream failures under large batch head-of-line. When a connection gets recycled mid-stream the upstream returns an early reset.
sre-bot: ALERT: spike in edge.gateway.502_rate eu-west-1 at 2026-06-12T11:12:xxZ, +18s over baseline. Top upstream: midproxy-hosted-1
alex_ops: Repro steps I tried: 1) Send 4000-token embed batch across 4 parallel requests at 200rps 2) Observe 502/retries within 30s 3) Restarting midproxy reduces error rate for ~90s then it climbs again.
jordan_eng: Can folks grep for `authcache.eviction` events and `keepalive_conn_reuse` in the edge logs. Also check midproxy connection window metrics: `midproxy.conn_window_in_use`.
kevin_sre: Quick mitigation idea: temporarily disable connection reuse on the client side (set `Connection: close`) for that tenant or reduce per-connection batch size to <100. Also increase midproxy keepalive timeout and bump auth-cache TTL by +30s as a stopgap.
maria_support: Noted, I'll pass mitigations to the customer (suggest batch chunking + SDK flag to disable keepalive). They prefer not to change batch sizes if we can fix infra quickly.
jordan_eng: From stack traces, Envoy returns 502 when the upstream closed before ACK. There's a small race where auth cache invalidation triggers re-auth request while the same tcp connection is being reused for a long streaming POST. If the upstream server cycles the worker, Envoy sees RST and returns 502.
kevin_sre: Add a temporary rule to route heavy-embed requests to a different midproxy pool (elastic pool) with a longer keepalive window. I can patch routing policy in 10-15m.
alex_ops: Patch applied to route X to pool-elastic-eu. Monitoring now.
sre-bot: NOTE: routing.policy.change by kevin_sre at 11:25 UTC.
kevin_sre: After reroute, 502 rate dropped from 4.2% to 0.6% for those request patterns. Still seeing occasional 504s on long tail.
jordan_eng: Next steps: add instrumentation to count `conn_reuse_count` per request and authcache hit/miss correlation. Plan a code fix to make auth cache revalidation non-blocking for in-flight streams (queued refresh instead of blocking request).
maria_support: I'll update customer with the short-term reroute + suggested client change. They're ok with SDK flag for now.
alex_ops: Saved sample traces and stack snippets in ticket #A-879 and in S3 at s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1767777123/traces.log
kevin_sre: I'll follow up with a postmortem and timeframe for permanent fix (likely a small runtime change + midproxy keepalive tuning). Tagging eng runtime for the authcache change.
jordan_eng: FYI I'll draft an eval to simulate high-concurrency embed bursts against midproxy pool and run in staging.
maria_support: Thanks all, marking this thread for handoff to eng-runtime. :thumbsup:
alex_ops: closing loop, will keep monitoring for ~24h and reopen if spike returns.
